rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Eresus Sentinel is a deterministic, YAML-driven security platform for auditing AI and MCP ecosystems. It includes an MCP proxy component that intercepts and inspects MCP protocol traffic in real-time using stdio or HTTP modes, enabling live JSON-RPC scanning, trust map validation, MCP schema verification, and permission auditing. The platform covers 48+ security probes across the AI stack and supports offline manifest analysis, live endpoint inspection, and stdio command wrapping.
